title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2611.31208v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given $n$ private and $n$ public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. Using the public points' affine span, we construct a smaller representation that preserves all matching costs. When a trusted server receives the private points, we establish privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, which randomizes edge costs and releases only the assignment. Through upper bounds and worst-case constructions, we establish the tight rate $\Theta\!\left(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon\right)$ for expected cost above the nonprivate optimum. Benchmark experiments support $d\approx\log n$ as a practical guide to the transition between directly randomizing point coordinates and using Gumbel matching. Extensions to squared Euclidean costs

translated_abstract: 我们研究如何在 $d$ 维欧几里得空间中表示和随机化点，以便在度量隐私约束下获得精确的二部匹配。给定 $n$ 个私有点和 $n$ 个公共点，我们分析了随机化每个私有点或其到公共点距离的局部机制。利用公共点的仿射张成空间，我们构建了一个更紧凑的表示，该表示能够保留所有匹配成本。当可信服务器接收私有点时，我们为 Gumbel 匹配建立了隐私和效用保证，该机制通过随机化边成本并仅发布分配结果来保护隐私。通过上界分析和最坏情形构造，我们证明了相对于非私有最优解的期望成本增量的紧致率为 $\Theta(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon)$。基准实验支持 $d\approx\log n$ 作为在直接随机化点坐标与使用 Gumbel 匹配两种方法之间切换的实用指导。本文还包含对平方欧几里得成本情形的扩展。
tldr: 本文研究了度量隐私下的二部匹配问题，通过利用公共点的仿射张成构建紧凑表示并建立 Gumbel 匹配机制的隐私与效用保证，证明了期望成本超出非私有最优解的紧致率为 Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε)。
en_tdlr: This paper studies bipartite matching under metric privacy, constructing a compact representation via the public points' affine span and establishing privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, proving a tight rate of Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε) for the expected cost above the nonprivate optimum.
